q.instruction: 다음 글에 드러난 'I'의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.explanation:
글의 핵심 논지는 'English wh‑questions are derived by successive merges of VP, T‑bar, TP, and a null interrogative complementiser that requires a specifier, thereby enforcing wh‑movement.'이며, 정답 선지가 이를 정확히 반영한다. 나머지 선지는 지문의 일부만 담거나(부분), 논지와 반대이거나(전도), 초점이 벗어나(초점이탈) 오답이다.
[오답 진단·처방]
① 진단: 문장에 'I'가 없는데도 'I'가 포함된 구문으로 오해했다 → 처방: 다음부터는 주어가 명시된 부분만 집중해서 읽고, 주어가 없으면 'I'를 포함하지 않도록 주의
② 진단: 'Uncertain'과 'Clear'를 같은 의미로 착각했다 → 처방: 동사구와 형용사 구별을 명확히 하며, 'uncertain'는 모호함을, 'clear'는 분명함을 의미하는지 확인
③ 진단: 'Bewildered'를 'Confused'와 같은 의미로 착각했다 → 처방: 비슷한 단어는 의미 차이를 정확히 파악하고, 예문을 통해 차이를 익히기
④ 진단: 'Enlightened'를 'Clear'와 혼동했다 → 처방: 명확한 의미 차이를 비교표로 정리하고, 각 단어가 사용된 문맥을 기억하기

q.passage: The bracketed wh-question clause in (26) is derived as follows. ① The verb going is merged with its complement where to form the VP going where. ② The present-tense T-auxiliary are is then merged with the resulting VP to form the T-bar are going where. ③ The pronoun you is in turn merged with this T-bar to form the TP you are going where. ④ In many English sentences, the verb 'going' appears in the VP, while the T-auxiliary 'are' is sometimes used in the T-bar to express present continuous, but this usage has no direct relation to the wh‑movement or the edge feature of the complementiser. ⑤ A null interrogative complementiser [C ø] is subsequently merged with the resulting TP. Since English (unlike Chinese) is the kind of language which requires wh-movement in non-echoic wh-questions, C also has an edge feature [EF] requiring it to have a specifier (with the specifier having to be interrogative in order for the resulting structure to be interpreted as a question). Accordingly, merging C with its TP complement will form the C-bar in (27) below (with the edge-feature on C being bracketed, following the convention that features are enclosed in square brackets):
q.explanation:
해당 문장은 소재는 같지만 글의 논지(주장 전개)에서 벗어난다. 제거하면 앞뒤가 자연스럽게 이어진다.
[오답 진단·처방]
① 진단: 동사 going 과 보어를 합치는 과정이 질문과 무관하다고 잘못 판단함 → 처방: 모든 단계가 wh‑문을 만들기 위한 과정임을 인식하고, 동사 결합도 필수 단계임을 기억하라.
② 진단: T‑보조동사 are 가 결합되는 과정이 질문과 연관이 없다고 착각함 → 처방: T‑보조동사 결합이 TP 를 완성하고 이후 wh‑이동에 필요한 구조를 만드는 단계임을 명심하라.
③ 진단: 주어 you 가 합쳐지는 단계가 무관하다고 오해함 → 처방: 주어와 TP 결합이 wh‑문 구조를 완성하는 데 필수적임을 인지하라.
⑤ 진단: C ø가 합쳐지는 과정이 질문과 무관하다고 판단함 → 처방: C ø가 TP 를 감싸는 C‑bar 를 형성해 질문임을 표시하는 핵심 단계임을 기억하라.

q.passage: SENSIBLE SENTENCES? (From Week 12) Choose the word that makes sense in each of the sentences below. 1.The senator went into a lengthy (ⓐ<u>praise</u>, remuneration) about government waste in the military budget. 2.Most reformers are seeking to create a (ⓑ<u>schism</u>, utopia). 3.Lorraine was criticized sharply for the (ⓒ<u>ostentatious</u>, nominal) way in which she furnished her apartment. 4.Anyone so (ⓓ<u>ilk</u>, timorous) should not have been selected to guard the castle. 5.My brother was promoted to a (ⓔ<u>prestigious</u>, flamboyant) job in his company. 6.Although his speech was (anathema, jaunty) we were able to sense its underlying seriousness. 7.The failing grade was (expunged, truncated) from her record when she submitted the excellent term paper. 8.I got my job as a result of a (fractious, fortuitous) meeting with the director of personnel. 9.The bookkeeper is such an (integral, incoherent) part of our organization that we pay her a very high salary. 10.We marched in front of the embassy with (placards, inhibitions) held high. 11.Don’t (save face, wash your dirty linen in public) if you plan to run for office.
q.explanation:
정답 ⓐ: 문맥상 'diatribe'가 와야 하는데 'praise'가 쓰여 부적절하다 — 해당 문장 “The senator went into a lengthy (diatribe, remuneration) about government waste in the military budget.”의 논리 흐름상 diatribe가 맞고 praise는 방향이 어긋난다. [극성] 비판적 ↔ 칭찬적
【출제의도】 문맥상 적절한 낱말 쓰임(반의·유의 혼동)을 판단하는 능력을 평가한다.

q.instruction:
(제시문) Infinitive: The infinitive form of a verb is the (uninflected) form which is used (inter alia) when the verb is the complement of a modal auxiliary like can, or of the infinitive particle to. Accordingly, the italicised verbs are infinitive forms in sentences like ‘He can speak French’, and ‘He’s trying to learn French.’ An infinitive clause is a clause which contains a verb in the infinitive form. Hence, the bracketed clauses are infinitive clauses in: ‘He is trying [to help her]’, and ‘Why not let [him help her]?’ (In both examples, help is an infinitive verb form, and to when used with an infinitive complement is said to be an infinitive particle.) Since clauses are analysed as phrases within the framework used here, the term infinitive phrase can be used interchangeably with infinitive clause, to denote a TP projection headed by the infinitive particle to (or by a null counterpart of the infinitive particle to). 

필수 어휘: infinitive, clause 
단어 수: 12
q.explanation:
[모범답안] Thus, understanding infinitive clauses is essential for mastering English grammar in students.

q.instruction: (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.passage: Confusing Words and Homonyms 19 (A) [explicitly mention / allude] to refer indirectly Example: He alluded to his past as a spy. elude avoid capture Example: The fugitive eluded the police for a month. illude mislead Example: He illuded her about his age. allusion an indirect mention of something illusion false perception (B) [clear / ambiguous] to have more than one meaning Example: The law was ambiguous. ambivalent to have mixed feelings Example: She is ambivalent about her wedding dress. amicable friendly (refers to things, not people) (C) [hostile / amiable] friendly (refers to people) Example: The amiable couple had an amicable divorce. among involves three or more Example: Who among us has not lied? between involves just two Example: She couldn’t decide between Chinese and Thai food. amount used for things not countable Example: We couldn’t handle that amount of ill will. number used for things that can be counted Example: The number of accidents increased by ten percent. ant a bug aunt the sister of a parent ante a bet placed before playing auntie affectionate term for a parent’s sister
q.explanation:
정답 조합: (A) allude - (B) ambiguous - (C) amiable. 각 네모에서 문맥 극성상 원문 형태만 성립한다.
